newsitem.title: CHINA: China declares HK 1997 legislature elected.
newsitem.headline: China declares HK 1997 legislature elected.

text.p: China declared on Saturday it had completed the election of a legislature to be installed in Hong Kong after the British colony reverts to Beijing in 1997.
"The Provisional Legislative Council (PLC) of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) was born through secret balloting here today," the official Xinhua news agency said.
It said the 60 members of the PLC were elected from among 130 candidates by a 400-member Selection Committee. The results of the vote were to be announced later in the day.
The body is to replace Hong Kong's elected Legislative Council when China takes over Hong Kong at midnight on June 30.
